{
  "summary": "At approximately 10:00 AM on May 20, 2024 (Turn 2), a two-person Utilities crew (U-A/U-B) was preparing for planned maintenance of the #1 slab caster dryer group in the RHOB process area. They had collected work folder WO-527 but had not yet received formal release/maintenance acceptance from Maintenance receiver M-A, nor completed boundary preparation.\n\nAt ~10:00 AM, an air-low indication occurred at the RHOB service station (Receiving header H-R). The crew paused work. By 10:07 AM, local indications returned to normal without a formal line opening or restoration procedure documented in this packet yet.",
  "focalEvent": "Loss of instrument-air pressure indicated by an alarm/indication at the RHOB service station while maintenance preparation was underway but not released.",
  "actualImpact": "Work paused; no injuries reported. Air supply restored within ~7 minutes (10:02-10:07).",
  "potentialImpact": "Loss of instrument air could have caused unintended valve movements, loss of control for safety systems, or inability to isolate equipment if a failure had persisted.",
  "normalState": "Utilities operations manages the North gallery and Dryer aisle; RHOB operations observes receiving header H-R. Normal pressure is in 'local band' (numeric value unknown).",
  "eventState": "At event time: Utilities crew at gallery preparing boundary; Maintenance receiver present but acceptance not signed/recorded as complete; no temporary instruction attached to WO-527.",
  "understoodFacts": [
    "Incident occurred during Turn 2 on May 20, 2024.",
    "Crew U-A/U-B had operating qualifications and energy-control authorization at shift start.",
    "Work order WO-527 was scheduled for planned maintenance of dryer group D-101.",", "
    ],"unknowns": [
      "Exact time the air pressure dropped (approximate 'About 10:00' in log).",
      "Whether the interruption originated at source, distribution system, or receiving equipment.",
      "Numeric value of low-pressure alarm threshold and normal band limits.",
      "Specific valve positions during the event.",
      "Reason for air restoration (automatic vs manual intervention not yet detailed).",
      "Status of any change records affecting service routing on May 20.",
      "Whether a temporary instruction was required but missing."],
  "questions": [
    {
      "intent": "Determine if the interruption originated upstream or downstream to clarify causal chain and responsible system boundary.",
      "text": "Did pressure monitoring at any point between the air source (North gallery) and RHOB receiving header H-R show a drop before, during, or after 10:00 AM? If so, where was the first indication of loss?",
    "rationale": "Distinguishes whether Utilities distribution failed versus an isolated event affecting only RHOB.","evidenceNeeded": ["Pressure trend logs for North gallery and Dryer aisle between 09:35-10:20.", "Alarm export times vs acknowledgment times from IA-S01."],"priority": "high","sourceIds": [
      "incident-description",
      "IA-D01_area_and_service_directory.md",
      "IA-S01_shift_and_notification_log.md"],"routedTo": ["human"],
    "causalBranch": "System boundary of failure (Source vs Distribution vs Receiving)"}, {
      "intent": "Verify if maintenance release/boundary acceptance was formally completed before the event.",
      "text": "Was Maintenance receiver M-A's signature on WO-527 obtained and recorded prior to 10:00 AM? If not, what specific boundary conditions were assumed or communicated verbally?",
    "rationale": "Determines if work proceeded without formal acceptance of energy boundaries, which is a procedural gap.",
      "evidenceNeeded": ["Signed copy of WO-527 maintenance release form (if exists).", "Interview with M-A regarding verbal agreements."],"priority": "high","sourceIds":["IA-S03_assignment_and_authorization_extract.md"],"routedTo":[],
    "causalBranch":"Procedural compliance"}, {
      "intent": "Identify if any recent changes to instrument-air routing or equipment configuration were in effect on May 20.",
      "text": "Were there any change records (ECP revisions, drawing redlines) affecting the RHOB service station or Dryer aisle active between March and April 2024 that might explain a transient loss?",
    "rationale": "Change management failures often cause unexpected behavior in energy systems.",
      "evidenceNeeded":["List of issued change records effective May 20, 2024.","Engineering disposition documents for any routing changes."],"priority":"medium","sourceIds":[],"routedTo":[],
    "causalBranch": "Change management"}, {
      "intent": "Clarify the mechanism and duration of air restoration.",
      "text": "Was pressure restored automatically by a redundant supply, manual valve operation, or system reset? Who performed any action between 10:02 AM and 10:07 AM?",
    "rationale": "Understanding restoration helps assess risk recurrence and whether safeguards were adequate.",
      "evidenceNeeded":["Field notes from U-A/U-B/M-A regarding actions taken.","Valve position records or SCADA snapshots."],"priority":"medium","sourceIds":[],"routedTo":[],
    "causalBranch": "System resilience"}],"decision": {
  "summary": "The incident involved a transient loss of instrument air at the RHOB service station during maintenance preparation. The crew had not yet received formal release/maintenance acceptance, and no temporary instruction was attached to WO-527. Key unknowns include the origin of the pressure drop (source vs distribution), exact timing relative to boundary status, and whether any recent changes affected system behavior.",
  "evidenceUsed": [
    "incident-description",
    "IA-D01_area_and_service_directory.md",
    "IA-S01_shift_and_notification_log.md",
    "IA-S02_work_package_cover.md",
    "IA-S03_assignment_and_authorization_extract.md"],
  "unknowns": [
    "Exact pressure drop origin and timing.",
    "Formal maintenance release status at event time.",
    "Recent change records affecting routing."],
  "alternatives": ["Pressure loss was a brief upstream fluctuation unrelated to the work area.","Loss occurred due to an unrecorded valve misposition during preparation.","A recent but undocumented change altered normal operation."],"confidence":0.65}

}
